content.short: Krebit enables users to prove their identity without revealing personal data.
content.description: Krebit is a pseudonymous identification platform that uses Ceramic’s Self.Id Decentralized Identity (DID) to help users control their personal data and profiles. By leveraging an open, multi-chain data model, Krebit enables Web3 developers to obtain real-time reputation information about any identity owner while preserving users’ privacy. This approach centers on user control over identity data and supports reliable reputation checks across chains without compromising privacy.
